Challenges{{scroll|color = var(--InfoboxBorder)|height = auto|text = *[[File:HealthIcon.png|20px|Health]]2,000 ([[Back to Basics (Challenge)|Back to Basics]])}} |defense = {{Defense}}50% |speed = [[File:SpeedIcon.png|20px|Speed]]Above Average (3.5) |cash = {{Money|5}} on death |spawned_by = *[[Nuclear Fallen King]] (Formerly) *[[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] *[[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]] *[[Mystery Boss]] (Legacy Fallen, Wave 38 onwards & Hardcore, Wave 46 onwards) |hidden = No |fly = No |ghost = No |lead = No |immunity = {{Attr|Stun}} }} {{QuoteContainer| {{QuoteBox|*Heavy footsteps.*|Beginning of Wave 39 (Pre-Overhaul, [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Fallen Hero''' is a variant of the [[Fallen]] enemy that appears in the [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] exclusive [[Legacy Fallen Mode|Legacy Fallen]] mode. It can be a threat to your defenses due to its high health and high defense of 50%, which decreases the damage dealt by most towers by about 33%, though due to damage dealt rounding up this is not always the case. It moves at an above average speed. It can be spawned by the [[Fallen King (Legacy)|Fallen King]] and [[Void Reaver (Legacy)|Void Reaver]]. It can be spawned by the [[Mystery Boss]] upon its death on Wave 38 onwards in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode and in [[Hardcore Mode|Hardcore]] mode, wave 46 onwards. The [[Nuclear Fallen King]] also could spawn the '''Fallen Hero'''. ==Appearance== The '''Fallen Hero''' has reflective black skin, dark blue granite armor and pants, and there are glowing purple parts on its shoulder-pads resembling skulls. It also wears a completely black reflective dominus. ==Strategy== *High DPS towers, such as the [[Ranger]], [[Minigunner]], [[Accelerator]] and [[Engineer]] are very useful against this. **Additionally, you can use [[Commander]] and [[DJ Booth]] to boost these towers' firerate and range, respectively. *Splash damage towers, such as the [[Pursuit]], [[Mortar]] and [[Rocketeer]] can be useful against the '''Fallen Hero''' as it typically spawns in hordes. **Additionally, splash damage towers ignore defense, making them even more effective against it. *You can use towers like the [[Sledger]], [[Electroshocker]] or [[Warden]] to slow this down. **Do note that the '''Fallen Hero's''' [[Stun Immunity]] makes stunning towers like the [[Electroshocker]] only slow it down instead of stopping it completely while knockback towers like the [[Brawler]] cannot knock it back. **Do also note that freezing towers and the [[Warden]] will only freeze or stun the '''Fallen Hero''' for a shorter amount of time due to its large size. *Defense dropping towers, such as the [[Pyromancer]] or [[Electroshocker]], are very useful against the '''Fallen Hero''' due to its high defense. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseLegacyFallenHero.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (12 March 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Renders}} Insane_Mode.png|Unused version of the '''Fallen Hero''' on a render. {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} April Fools 2022 - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Fallen Hero''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Development Images}} Darkbossleak.png|'''Fallen Hero''' on a Development Image. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} War Machine Upgrade 5.png|'''Fallen Hero''' on the [[War Machine]]’s Level 5 upgrade icon and [[Accelerator]]’s first Level 5 icon. IndexLFallenHero.png|'''Fallen Hero''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *Because of the [[Mystery Boss]], the '''Fallen Hero''' can appear before its first wave appearance in [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode. *On the original [[Fallen Mode|Fallen]] mode icon, the '''Fallen Hero''' has a slightly different appearance. Its skull shoulder-pads are the {{RLinkC|4765718|The Riddling Skull}} accessory from the Roblox catalog, instead of the skull shoulder-pads it currently uses. *The '''Fallen Hero''' looks similar to the first version of the [[w:c:roblox-tower-battles:Guardian|Guardian]] from ''Tower Battles''. *Multiple '''Fallen Heroes''' can be seen as chess pieces in the [[Chess Board]] map, representing the Rook chess piece. ==Update History== {{Scroll|text= *'''13 October 2019''' -
